Enter a date format to preview it directly. Common format symbols are case-sensitive. Restart the scope after saving.
You can also combine time fields, such as HH:mm. Lunar calendar and solar term symbols are shown only in supported system UI.

Time formats extend ISO 8601. Custom clock format reference:

ISO 8601 date formats:
 yyyy - Year (2024)
 yy - Last two year digits (24)
 MM - Month (12)
 MMM - Abbreviated month (Dec)
 MMMM - Full month name (December)
 dd - Day (25)
 HH - 24-hour clock (14)
 hh - 12-hour clock (02)
 mm - Minute (30)
 ss - Second (45)
 SSS - Millisecond (123)

Weekday formats:
 E - Abbreviated weekday (Mon)
 EE - Abbreviated weekday (Mon)
 EEE - Abbreviated weekday (Mon)
 EEEE - Full weekday name (Monday)
 u - Numeric weekday (1-7, 1=Monday)
 W - Custom weekday format (Mon)

Lunar calendar:
 N - Lunar date
 J - Solar term (shown only on that day)
 A - Zodiac animal

Time-related:
 T - Traditional two-hour period
 a - AM/PM marker
 k - 24-hour clock (1-24)
 K - 12-hour clock (0-11)

Other special formats:
 C - Zodiac sign
 D - Day of year (1-365)
 F - Week of month
 w - Week of year (1-53)
 W - Week of month (1-5)
 z - Time zone name (GMT+08:00)
 Z - Time zone offset (+0800)

Examples:
 "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss" -> "2024-12-25 14:30:45"
 "MM-dd EEEE" -> "12-25 Wednesday"
 "HH:mm T" -> "14:30 noon period"
 "yyyy-MM-dd N A" -> "2024-12-25 Lunar 23rd Dragon"
 "yyyy/MM/dd E C" -> "2024/12/25 Wed Capricorn"

Notes:
 • Lunar dates and solar terms use the Chinese lunar calendar algorithm
 • Traditional periods are divided into two-hour blocks
 • Zodiac signs are calculated from the Gregorian date
 • Zodiac animals are based on lunar year
 • Custom format symbols (N,J,T,C,A,W) are case-sensitive
